# Builders use as many branches as they need, 2026-11-20

`AGENTS.md`, under Work from issues, now says a builder creates a branch of its own for each pull request without asking. The maintainer said so on 2026-11-20, in the coordinator's session. Five builders in cloud sessions had stopped that week to ask him for a second branch, each time with finished work and nowhere to push it. No code changed, and no file here guards trust or durability.
